girdi.command: ls -R core | head -60 && echo "=== AGENTS ===" && cat AGENTS.md
girdi.description: List core tree and read AGENTS.md

girdi.command: cd core/hooks && grep -n "^function \|^const .*= (\|module.exports" lib.js | tail -60 && echo "=== wc ===" && wc -l lib.js defter.js kitap.js count.js

cd core/hooks && grep -n "^function short\|^function lastText\|^function job\|LEDGER =\|module.exports" defter.js && echo "--- short ---" && sed -n "/^function short/,/^}/p" defter.js && echo "=== kitap ===" && grep -n "^function \|module.exports" kitap.js && echo "--- audit ---" && sed -n "/^function audit/,/^}/p" kitap.js

cd core/hooks && grep -n "^function file\|^function sum\|^function handle\|module.exports" count.js && sed -n "/^function file/,/^}/p;/^function sum/,/^}/p" count.js && echo "=== mod.items ===" && sed -n "/^function items/,/^}/p" mod.js && echo "=== jobs mark write ===" && grep -n "jobs-\|sira-" mod.js defter.js | head -20
